releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.139:
- SINGLE PROMINENT SAVE BUTTON: Maintained one clear, prominent green SAVE CHANGES button in the modal footer to eliminate ambiguity.
- MODIFIER COLUMNS NUMBERING & SHIFT ARROWS: Added column numbers (#1, #2, #3) and left/right arrows (◀ / ▶) in modifier column headers for dynamic group reordering.
- MODIFIER ITEMS UP/DOWN REORDERING: Added up/down arrows (▲ / ▼) on every modifier option to easily reorder ingredients, meats, and addons.
- STATION INDEPENDENCE & SAFE POWER CONTROLS: Remote cashier stations reload screens locally; remote server shutdowns and reboots are permanently blocked.
- NATIVE DIGITALPERSONA AUTO-STARTUP ON EVERY PC: DPFPBridge.exe is registered in Windows Startup and auto-spawned by the app on all cashier machines.
- CATEGORY TABS RESTORED IN PRODUCT INVENTORY: Dynamic category tabs bar (ALL, COMIDA, DRINKS, PAN, POSTRES, STORE, SIDES) active with one-tap filtering.
- 100% Quality Standard: 0 errors and 0 warnings verified across all integrity auditors.
